# How many of your Substack readers pay, and how long do they stay?

> Free analyzer for Substack writers: drop in your subscribers export CSV and see paid, free and former subscribers, free-to-paid conversion, paid retention, revenue by plan, annual renewals due and growth. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
